content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00203, SRS_Rte_00167 For each VariationPointProxy which bindingTime = preCompileTime the RTE Configuration Header File shall contain a definition of a Condition Value Macro in the RTE PreBuild Data Set Contract Phase and RTE PreBuild Data Set Generation Phase #define Rte_SysCon_<cts>_<name> <value><suffix> Where <cts> is the component type symbol of the AtomicSwComponentType , <name> is the shortName of the VariationPointProxy , <value> is the evaluated value of the AttributeValueVariationPoint or Con- ditionByFormula and <suffix> shall be set according to [SWS_Rte_03619].
